answer.summary: The API types check failed because the committed openaev-front/src/utils/api-types.d.ts does not match what the generator produces from the current API. The only diff is a line-wrap of ScenarioUpdateInput.scenario_update_choices, which the PR's ScenarioUpdateInput.java change makes stale. The types were not regenerated before committing, so a re-run will reproduce the same diff. Fix: run yarn generate-types-from-api and commit the result.

evidence.quote: ⚠️ Forgot to generate types! Please run 'yarn run generate-types-from-api' before committing.
